_meta.note: brief_hex = palette from the canonical sheet. observed_render_hex = median colour sampled from the lit main illustration in FOX_V2_BASELINE.png (includes lighting, so it is a check value, not a base colour). model_hex = base colour actually used in Blender (sRGB). Colour management: view transform 'Standard' so base colours are not tone-mapped.
_meta.shading_model: Principled BSDF, matte soft-vinyl / clay look; no textures, no fur, no noise

MAT_Fox_Orange.r3_note: Gate C r3: base tuned for saturation under the unchanged review lighting; renders #FF9744 (h27 s0.73) vs reference #FE9942 (h28 s0.74). r2 base #FF8A3D rendered #FF944F (h24 s0.69). Brief palette value unchanged.
MAT_Fox_Orange.use: head, body, arms, legs, ears (outer), tail base, tuft

MAT_Fox_Cream.use: face mask, belly, inner ears, tail tip

MAT_Backpack_Green.decision: Gate C r2 (user): base colour moved to the olive #688E52 seen in every rendered reference view; soft matte finish (roughness 0.82, light sheen).

lighting_for_review.setup: warm soft key (front-left-top), fill (front-right), rim (back), low-intensity warm world; orthographic cameras; Cycles; shadow catcher composited onto background
